records.source: By combining their collected eggs... Jas and Vincent!$1
records.translation: Sa pagsasama-sama ng mga nakolekta nilang itlog... sina Jas at Vincent!$1

records.source: Go away, we're adversaries until the egg hunt is over!$h
records.translation: Lumayo ka, magkalaban tayo hanggang matapos ang paghahanap ng itlog!$h

records.source: I never had many friends in town, so these events are always kind of boring for me. I enjoy the buffet, though.
records.translation: Hindi ako nagkaroon ng maraming kaibigan sa bayan, kaya medyo nakakabagot para sa akin ang mga ganitong pagtitipon. Pero nasisiyahan ako sa handaan.

records.source: I'm just catching up with Penny. Have you had your fill of eggs?
records.translation: Nakikipagkuwentuhan lang ako kay Penny. Nagsawa ka na ba sa mga itlog?

records.source: Maru's trying to convince me to eat a deviled egg. I'm just not sure I can stomach it...
records.translation: Sinusubukan akong kumbinsihin ni Maru na kumain ng pinalamang itlog. Hindi ko lang tiyak kung kakayanin ng sikmura ko...

records.source: I was going to eat some eggs, but then I remembered I'm on a spring diet.
records.translation: Kakain sana ako ng ilang itlog, pero naalala kong nagdidiyeta ako ngayong tagsibol.

records.source: I'll be rooting for you in the egg hunt.$h
records.translation: Susuportahan kita sa paghahanap ng itlog.$h

records.source: The gang's just the same as always. Are you having a good time?
records.translation: Gaya pa rin ng dati ang barkada. Nagsasaya ka ba?

records.source: Ungh... I think I ate a dozen too many hard boiled eggs...$s
records.translation: Ungh... Mukhang napasobra ako ng isang dosenang nilagang itlog...$s

records.source: How is everyone doing? I'm just taking a break for a little while. I'm looking forward to seeing you in the egg hunt!
records.translation: Kumusta ang lahat? Nagpapahinga lang ako sandali. Sabik akong mapanood ka sa paghahanap ng itlog!

records.source: I enjoy seeing you so relaxed, my dear.$h
records.translation: Nasisiyahan akong makita kang panatag, mahal ko.$h

records.source: Searching for eggs is like going on a treasure hunt.$h
records.translation: Ang paghahanap ng mga itlog ay parang paghahanap ng kayamanan.$h

records.source: Spring is a busy time of year... so it's nice to have a day off to catch up with friends.
records.translation: Abalang panahon ng taon ang tagsibol... kaya masarap magkaroon ng isang araw na pahinga para makipagkuwentuhan sa mga kaibigan.

records.source: Egg... what a strange thing to eat.
records.translation: Itlog... kakaibang bagay na kainin.

records.source: I always look forward to these gatherings... it makes the valley feel like a real community.
records.translation: Lagi kong inaasam ang mga pagtitipong ito... ipinadarama nitong isa talagang komunidad ang lambak.

records.source: We used to do a rotten egg toss...#$b#Mayor Lewis put an end to that pretty quick.
records.translation: Dati, naghahagisan kami ng bulok na itlog...#$b#Mabilis iyong ipinatigil ni Alkalde Lewis.
